stories.title: Phishing Campaign Targets Employees with Malicious SVG Files
stories.summary: Researchers at INKY observed a major phishing campaign that used SVG (Scalable Vector Graphics) image files to deliver malicious JavaScript. While abuse of SVG files isn’t new, INKY says their use in phishing campaigns has exploded over the past year.

stories.summary: Gabriel Attal launched what he called the '1,000 bistros' campaign, brandishing a half pint of beer. Groups said his video violated the French law regulating the promotion of alcohol.

kev.name: MikroTik RouterOS Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command Vulnerability
kev.summary: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacked to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.

entries.title: The leak didn't move the date
entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.

entries.title: Someone is counter-programming launch day
entries.body: Devolver Digital has a mystery game dated 19 November. Pre-orders have been open since June: Standard $79.99, Ultimate $99.99, no special edition.
